title: Ryobi ONE+ 18V Cordless Electrostatic 1-Gal Sprayer Kit with (2) 2.0Ah Batteries and Charger (P2870)

comparisons.notes: Exact P2870 kit with (2) 2.0Ah batteries and charger, Internet #314154445; page shows $229.00, limit 5 per order, no out-of-stock notice.

writeup: Woot has Ryobi's ONE+ 18V cordless electrostatic 1-gallon sprayer kit (model P2870) new for $59.99, and it comes with two 2.0Ah batteries plus a charger. The Home Depot sells the same P2870 kit for $229, so this is about 73% less. Woot listed only 3 left with a limit of 3 per customer.
